properties.name: Meteo T157 AP
properties.description: Show highest precipitation record of the highest point in City of Zurich during ISO week 46 of 2011.

properties.name: Annotate Meteo Dataset Operator
properties.description: Annotate the meteo tables with provenance information

properties.name: T157 SQL Query Operator
properties.description: Show highest precipitation record of the highest point in City of Zurich during ISO week 46 of 2011.
properties.query:
WITH place_0 AS (
  SELECT
    me.latitude AS latitude,
    me.longitude AS longitude,
    me.elevation AS elevation
  FROM meteo_elevation AS me
  WHERE
    (ROUND(CAST(me.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1), ROUND(CAST(me.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)) IN ((47.4, 8.5))
  ORDER BY
    elevation DESC
  LIMIT 1
), precip_at_highest_point AS (
  SELECT
    tp.tp AS tp,
    tp.time AS time,
    hp.latitude AS latitude,
    hp.longitude AS longitude,
    hp.elevation AS elevation
  FROM meteo_tp AS tp
  INNER JOIN place_0 AS hp
    ON ROUND(CAST(tp.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1) = ROUND(CAST(hp.latitude AS DECIMAL), 1)
    AND ROUND(CAST(tp.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1) = ROUND(CAST(hp.longitude AS DECIMAL), 1)
  WHERE
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM tp.time) = 46 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tp.time) = 2011
)
SELECT
  precip_at_highest_point.latitude AS latitude,
  precip_at_highest_point.longitude AS longitude,
  precip_at_highest_point.elevation AS highest_point_elevation_m,
  MAX(precip_at_highest_point.tp) AS highest_precipitation_record_m
FROM precip_at_highest_point
GROUP BY
  precip_at_highest_point.latitude,
  precip_at_highest_point.longitude,
  precip_at_highest_point.elevation
